title: CPI food and non-alcoholic beverages
description: Japan national CPI food and non-alcoholic beverages (COICOP 2018 division 01): the Statistics Bureau's published COICOP classification index from January 2021 (index, m/m, y/y as published); January 2011 to December 2020 an Asia Decoded calculation on the Bureau's item assignment (y/y only). Column basis says which.
schedule: Copied from the asia-vitals GitHub repository on Japan CPI release days
